articles.title: Romeo Is a Dead Man Brings Gameplay Maturity to Suda51’s Signature Madness
articles.description: After playing the first two chapters of Romeo Is a Dead Man, the latest mad science experiment of an action game helmed by Suda51, it clearly takes some big steps forward in art design and presentation that really raises the “Wow I didn’t see that coming” bar. Even the action, though not revolutionary, feels like a real commitment has been made to evolve the studio’s image from “crazy fun games to watch clips from” to “crazy fun games to spend countless hours with.”
